description: Get the BORME report of one company by slug: identity (name, CIF, legal form, status, aliases), KPIs (number of acts, first/last seen), activity timeline by period, top event types and provinces, the most recent registry events, and current and historical officers. Use it for "tell me about company X". `events_limit` (default 10) bounds the event list; page the full history with borme_get_company_events. The report is documentary: it reflects BORME publications, not a certified registry extract.

events_limit.description: How many of the most recent BORME events to include, 0-200 (default 10; 0 = none). The full history is paginated by borme_get_company_events.

slug.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_get_company
